explanation: Thirteen years separate the landing at Holetown from the cane that changed everything, and in those thirteen years Barbados was a tobacco colony of tenants working for a London merchant. That is the point of keeping the two records apart rather than writing one: the settlement is not the sugar revolution and did not contain it in embryo. What it supplied was an English island with cleared ground, a population and a proprietor — the thing Drax could bring a mill back to in 1640.
